data.name: Arnuad
data.gender_notes: Arnuad is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arnuad is derived from the Greek name Arneios, which means 'strong, brave, and powerful'. In Greek mythology, Arneios was a god of fertility and growth, symbolizing the strength and power needed for new life to thrive. The name Arnuad carries the meaning “Strong, brave, and powerful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Arnuad usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, brave, and powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arnuad total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
